summary: ICF International filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results and a routine quarterly dividend declaration. Revenue rose 1% to $470 million with federal client revenue up 3.4% sequentially; GAAP EPS was $1.76 and non-GAAP EPS $1.98, up 19%, on EBITDA of $53.6 million. The board declared a $0.14 per share quarterly cash dividend payable January 8, 2027 to holders of record December 4, 2026. Neither item constitutes a special situation; the dividend is ordinary capital return policy rather than a special distribution, and guidance was maintained at the midpoint on lower revenue.
